founded.yearLabel: one of the two oldest Olukumi towns

summary.text: Ukwu Nzu (Eko Efun), the largest Olukumi town, says its founders came in the retinue of Orunmiha, sent from Ife. It became a centre of the Ekumeku resistance.

founders.text: Its founders came with Orunmiha, sent from Ife to rule Benin.
